title: 第319章 玉玺之争第318章 墨家巨子
content_zh:
“天机老人”四个字，如同一块巨石投入平静的湖面，在众人眼中激起层层涟漪。
徐长生瞳孔骤然一缩，手中的游龙剑下意识地握紧了几分。
天机老人竟然离开了他的乌龟壳，在此时此刻，此情此景之下，踏入这座大秦帝陵。
天机老人缓步踏入地宫，周身气息浑厚深沉，如同一座无形的山岳缓缓压落。
他身后隐约有五道金色光晕流转不息，每一道光晕中都透出一股沉厚的国运之力，正是燕、楚、魏、赵、韩五国的玉玺之力。
“墨家巨子，久仰大名。”天机老人微微拱手，嘴角噙着一抹似有若无的笑意，“老夫曾推演天机，算出大秦帝陵之中有一道残魂镇守，却没想到竟是阁下。”
“能在此处得见墨家最后一任巨子，倒是老夫此行一大幸事。”
墨家巨子目光如电，沉声道：“你竟然已经炼化了五国玉玺！”
“老夫收集这五国玉玺，耗费了近百年的光阴。如今只差这一枚大秦玉玺，以及鲁国那一枚，便能集齐七国玉玺，完成那件大事。”
天机老人目光缓缓转向徐长生，带着一丝玩味，“你手里的那枚鲁国玉玺，也该一并交出来了。”
徐长生与他对视，没有丝毫退让，“你觉得可能吗？”
“少年人，你有三具化神境的傀儡尸，身边还有一个化神境的狐妖，确实有几分底气。”
“但你可知道，老夫今日既然敢走进这座帝陵，自然是做了万全的准备。”
话音落下的瞬间，天机老人周身的气息骤然暴涨。
一种远超化神境的恐怖威压从他体内弥漫开来，如同一座无形的山岳骤然降临在地宫之中。
那股威压层层叠叠地向四周扩散，整座地宫都在微微震颤，穹顶上的夜明珠纷纷爆裂，化作一片片细碎的星芒散落。
“炼虚境！”墨家巨子的眉头猛地一拧，眼中闪过一丝凝重。
“老夫筹划千年，等的就是今天。”天机老人笑容愈深，“五国玉玺之中蕴含的国运之力，足以让老夫在短时间内踏足炼虚。”
“墨家巨子，你以一缕残魂镇守此处数千年，已是油尽灯枯。若是乖乖交出玉玺，老夫可以留你一丝残魂转世投胎，如何？”
墨家巨子缓缓抬起手，指尖虚握，一柄由金光凝聚而成的长剑在他掌中显化而出。

“兼爱非攻，是墨家之道。”
“背信弃义，非墨家所为。”
“老夫既然答应了秦王镇守此处，便绝不会让你拿走玉玺。”
“冥顽不灵。”天机老人摇了摇头，五指骤然张开。
五道颜色各异的灵光从他指尖迸发而出，化作五条灵光锁链，直取墨家巨子所在方位。
墨家巨子手中金色长剑横斩而出，一道凌厉的金光如同弯月般划破虚空，将那五条灵光锁链一并斩断。
两人之间的碰撞无声无息，爆发的冲击波却将地宫地面掀开一层又一层石板碎片，如同风暴卷过一片纸海。
“破！”
墨家巨子低喝一声，身形骤然暴起，金光长剑裹挟着开天裂地之势，直斩天机老人胸膛。
天机老人双手结印，五枚玉玺再度浮现于身前，组成一道五色流转的光幕。
金光长剑狠狠斩在光幕之上，发出一声震耳欲聋的巨响，整座地宫都跟着剧烈晃动。
天机老人面色微变，显然墨家巨子这一剑的威力超出了他的预期。
他反手一推，五色光幕骤然炸裂，化作无数流光碎片，将墨家巨子的身形逼退数丈。
“以一缕残魂之躯，还能发挥出如此实力，不愧是墨家巨子。”
天机老人深吸一口气，面色沉了几分，“不过，你还能支撑多久？”
墨家巨子的身形微微晃动了一下，金光凝聚的身影比方才暗淡了一些。
他确实支撑不了太久，每一次出手都在消耗他残魂之中仅存的力量。
“前辈！”
“将玉玺交给我！”
content_en:
The four words "Old Man Tianji" are like a huge stone thrown into a calm lake, causing ripples in everyone's eyes.
Xu Changsheng's pupils suddenly shrank, and he subconsciously tightened his grip on the Dragon Sword in his hand.
Old Man Tianji actually left his tortoise shell, and at this moment, under this situation, stepped into the mausoleum of the Great Qin Emperor.
Old Man Tianji slowly stepped into the underground palace. The aura around him was thick and deep, like an invisible mountain slowly pressing down.
There are five golden haloes floating around behind him, and each halo reveals a profound power of national destiny, which is the power of the jade seals of the five kingdoms of Yan, Chu, Wei, Zhao, and Han.
"The great man of the Mohist family, I have admired his name for a long time." Old Man Tianji cupped his hands slightly, with a faint smile on his lips, "I once deduced Tianji and calculated that there is a remnant soul guarding the mausoleum of the Great Qin Emperor, but I didn't expect it to be Your Excellency."
"It is a great blessing for me to meet the last great figure of the Mo family here."
The Mohist giant's eyes were like lightning, and he said in a deep voice: "You have actually refined the jade seals of the Five Kingdoms!"
"I have spent nearly a hundred years collecting the jade seals of the Five Kingdoms. Now I only have one jade seal from Qin and one from Lu to collect all the jade seals from the Seven Kingdoms and complete that great event."
Old Man Tianji slowly turned his gaze to Xu Changsheng, with a hint of amusement, "It's time to hand over the Lu State Jade Seal in your hand."
Xu Changsheng looked at him without giving in at all, "Do you think it's possible?"
"Young man, you have three puppet corpses of the God Transformation Realm and a fox demon of the God Transformation Realm beside you. You do have some confidence."
"But you know, since I dare to enter this imperial mausoleum today, I have naturally made complete preparations."
The moment the words fell, the aura around Old Man Tianji suddenly surged.
A terrifying coercion that far exceeded the realm of gods spread from his body, like an invisible mountain suddenly descending into the underground palace.
The coercion spread layer by layer to the surroundings, and the entire underground palace trembled slightly. The night pearls on the dome burst into pieces and scattered into tiny stars.
"Refining the Void Realm!" The giant of the Mo family frowned suddenly, and a trace of solemnity flashed in his eyes.
"I have been planning for thousands of years, and I have been waiting for today." Old Man Tianji's smile deepened, "The power of national destiny contained in the jade seal of the Five Kingdoms is enough for me to set foot on the cultivation of the void in a short time."
"Young master of the Mohist family, you have guarded this place for thousands of years with a wisp of your remnant soul, but you have run out of energy. If you hand over the jade seal obediently, I can leave a wisp of your remnant soul to reincarnate, how about that?"
The Mohist giant slowly raised his hand, holding it with his fingertips, and a long sword condensed with golden light appeared in his palm.
"Love without aggression is the Mohist way."
"Breach of trust is not the fault of the Mohists."
"Since I promised King Qin to guard this place, I will never let you take away the jade seal."
"Stubborn." Old Man Tianji shook his head and suddenly spread his fingers.
Five auras of different colors burst out from his fingertips and turned into five aura chains, heading straight for the location of the Mo family giant.
The golden long sword in the hand of the Mohist giant slashed out horizontally, and a sharp golden light cut through the void like a crescent moon, cutting off the five spiritual light chains.
The collision between the two was silent, but the shock wave that erupted lifted up layer after layer of stone fragments on the underground palace floor, like a storm rolling through a sea of ​​paper.
"Broken!"
The giant of the Mohist family gave a low shout, and his figure suddenly rose up. With the force of the golden sword splitting the sky and the earth, it slashed straight into the chest of the old man Tianji.
Old Man Tianji formed a seal with his hands, and five jade seals appeared in front of him again, forming a five-color light curtain.
The golden sword slashed hard on the light curtain, making a deafening sound, and the entire underground palace shook violently.
Old Man Tianji's expression changed slightly, and it was obvious that the power of the Mohist giant's sword exceeded his expectations.
He pushed with his backhand, and the five-color light curtain suddenly exploded and turned into countless fragments of light.The film pushed the Mohist giant back several feet.
"With a body with a broken soul, he can still exert such strength. He is worthy of being a giant of the Mohist family."
Old Man Tianji took a deep breath and his face became a little darker, "But, how long can you last?"
The figure of the Mohist giant swayed slightly, and the figure condensed with golden light was darker than before.
He really couldn't hold on for long. Every time he took a shot, he was consuming the remaining strength in his soul.
"Senior!"
"Give me the jade seal!"
